atoms.name: div
atoms.rule: a / b divides and rounds toward zero (-7 / 2 = -3); b = 0 gives NaN.
atoms.plain: a / b divides and rounds toward zero (-7 / 2 = -3); b = 0 gives NaN.
atoms.plain_zh: a / b 是向零取整的除法，b = 0 时结果为 NaN。

atoms.name: mod
atoms.rule: a % b is the remainder a - b * (a / b), with the sign of a (-7 % 2 = -1); b = 0 gives NaN.
atoms.plain: a % b is the remainder a - b * (a / b), with the sign of a (-7 % 2 = -1); b = 0 gives NaN.
atoms.plain_zh: a % b 是余数 a - b * (a / b)，符号与 a 相同，b = 0 时结果为 NaN。

atoms.name: neg
atoms.rule: - a is the negation of a.
atoms.plain: - a is the negation of a.
atoms.plain_zh: - a 是 a 的相反数。

atoms.name: reverse
atoms.rule: a @ reverses the decimal digits of |a| and keeps the sign of a (120 @ = 21, -123 @ = -321).
atoms.plain: a @ reverses the decimal digits of |a| and keeps the sign of a (120 @ = 21, -123 @ = -321).
atoms.plain_zh: a @ 把 |a| 的十进制数字倒过来写，再保留 a 的符号。

atoms.name: triangle
atoms.rule: # a is sign(a) * |a| * (|a| + 1) / 2, computed exactly; only its result is checked against the bound (# 4 = 10, # -4 = -10).
atoms.plain: # a is sign(a) * |a| * (|a| + 1) / 2, computed exactly; only its result is checked against the bound (# 4 = 10, # -4 = -10).
atoms.plain_zh: # a 是带符号三角数 sign(a) * |a| * (|a| + 1) / 2。

atoms.name: popcount
atoms.rule: a $ is the number of 1 bits in the binary form of |a| (7 $ = 3).
atoms.plain: a $ is the number of 1 bits in the binary form of |a| (7 $ = 3).
atoms.plain_zh: a $ 是 |a| 的二进制里 1 的个数。

atoms.name: digitsum
atoms.rule: & a is sign(a) times the sum of the decimal digits of |a| (& -123 = -6).
atoms.plain: & a is sign(a) times the sum of the decimal digits of |a| (& -123 = -6).
atoms.plain_zh: & a 是 |a| 的各位数字之和，再乘上 a 的符号。

domain.en: Values are hours 0 to 11; inputs and results are reduced modulo 12.
domain.zh: 取值是 0 到 11 的时刻，输入和结果都对 12 取模。

settings.en: The preset that selects these atoms and defaults.
settings.zh: 选择这些原子和默认设置的预设。

settings.en: Every integer input, literal, and result is reduced modulo this number.
settings.zh: 每个整数输入、常数和结果都对这个数取模。

settings.en: A recursive call reduces its counter modulo a number drawn from this range, so it unfolds fewer times than that number.
settings.zh: 递归计数先对这个范围里抽到的数取模，所以展开次数小于这个数。

settings.en: The range of numbers in generated expressions and branch thresholds.
settings.zh: 生成算式和分支阈值所用的数值范围。

why.en: These atoms are one example. Atoms are chosen by the user: any function with a rule can be registered and the same three composition forms grow operators from it.
why.zh: 这些原子只是一个例子。原子由用户自己选：任何写得出规则的函数都能注册，同样三种组合方式会从它长出新运算符。

operators.name: △₁
operators.plain: Subtract the signed triangle number of a from b.
operators.plain_zh: 从 b 中减去「a 的带符号三角数」。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ♢₂
operators.definition: a ♢₂ b = { (# b) ◆₉, if a < 4 and b >= 7; b, if a >= 4 and a < 5 and b < 6; (a $) - (a @), else }
operators.plain: If a < 4 and b ≥ 7, take the signed triangle number of b, then apply ◆₉ to the result; otherwise if 4 ≤ a < 5 and b < 6, return b; otherwise count the one bits of a, then subtract a with its digits reversed from it.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 4 且 b ≥ 7，先求 b 的带符号三角数，再对结果应用 ◆₉；否则若 4 ≤ a < 5 且 b < 6，结果为 b；否则先数 a 的二进制里有几个 1，再从结果中减去「a 的数字倒写」。

operators.name: ◇₃
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b % 9| times: apply ■₁₅ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b % 9| 次：对结果应用 ■₁₅。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: ■₄
operators.plain: Reverse the digits of a, then add ♧₈ b to it.
operators.plain_zh: 先把 a 的数字倒过来写，再把结果加上 ♧₈ b。

operators.name: ☆₅
operators.plain: Count the one bits of a, then add a to it.
operators.plain_zh: 先数 a 的二进制里有几个 1，再把结果加上 a。

operators.name: ●₆
operators.plain: Take the signed triangle number of b, then divide it by -a, rounding toward zero.
operators.plain_zh: 先求 b 的带符号三角数，再把结果除以 -a 并向零取整。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: ▽₇
operators.plain: Negate a, then add the result to itself.
operators.plain_zh: 先把 a 取相反数，再把结果与自身相加。

operators.name: ♧₈
operators.plain: Compute 9 ●₆ a.
operators.plain_zh: 对 9 和 a 应用 ●₆。

operators.name: ◆₉
operators.plain: Add a ▽₇ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 加上 a ▽₇。

operators.name: ●₁₀
operators.plain: Subtract 3 from a.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 中减去 3。

operators.name: □₁₁
operators.plain: Apply ◆₉ to a, then apply △₁ to the result and (b ●₁₀).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ◆₉，再对结果和 b ●₁₀ 应用 △₁。

operators.name: ♡₁₂
operators.plain: Compute a ●₆ a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ●₆。

operators.name: ♣₁₃
operators.plain: Apply ☆₅ to b, then apply △₁ to the result and (a ☆₅).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 b 应用 ☆₅，再对结果和 a ☆₅ 应用 △₁。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ♧₁₄
operators.plain: Sum the digits of a, then add a to it.
operators.plain_zh: 先求 a 的各位数字之和，再把结果加上 a。

operators.name: ■₁₅
operators.plain: Apply △₁ to 3 and a, then apply ☆₅ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 3 和 a 应用 △₁，再对结果应用 ☆₅。

operators.name: ●₁₆
operators.plain: Apply ●₆ to b and a, then apply ▽₇ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 b 和 a 应用 ●₆，再对结果应用 ▽₇。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ♣₁₇
operators.plain: Multiply a by a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 乘以 a。

operators.name: ▼₁₈
operators.plain: Negate a, then apply △₁ to the result and (2 ♧₁₄).
operators.plain_zh: 先把 a 取相反数，再对结果和 2 ♧₁₄ 应用 △₁。

operators.name: ☆₁₉
operators.definition: a ☆₁₉ b = { ♡₁₂ b, if a >= 10 and b >= 3 and b < 6; a, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 10 and b ≥ 3 and b < 6, apply ♡₁₂ to b; otherwise return a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 10 且 b ≥ 3 且 b < 6，对 b 应用 ♡₁₂；否则结果为 a。

operators.name: ☆₂₀
operators.definition: a ☆₂₀ b = { ♡₁₂ (a ☆₁₉ 7), if a >= 2 and a < 6 and b < 8; - (a ◆₉), if a < 2 and b >= 10; (- a) ♣₁₃ (b $), else }
operators.plain: If 2 ≤ a < 6 and b < 8, apply ☆₁₉ to a and 7, then apply ♡₁₂ to the result; otherwise if a < 2 and b ≥ 10, apply ◆₉ to a, then negate it; otherwise negate a, then apply ♣₁₃ to the result and (the number of one bits in b).
operators.plain_zh: 若 2 ≤ a < 6 且 b < 8，先对 a 和 7 应用 ☆₁₉，再对结果应用 ♡₁₂；否则若 a < 2 且 b ≥ 10，先对 a 应用 ◆₉，再把结果取相反数；否则先把 a 取相反数，再对结果和「b 的二进制中 1 的个数」应用 ♣₁₃。

operators.name: ♠₂₁
operators.definition: a ♠₂₁ = { ♡₁₂ a, if a >= 9; a ■₄ a, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 9, apply ♡₁₂ to a; otherwise compute a ■₄ a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 9，对 a 应用 ♡₁₂；否则把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ■₄。

operators.name: ♧₂₂
operators.definition: ♧₂₂ a = { (7 ●₁₀) ●₆ (a ♧₁₄), if a >= 2 and a < 7; ♧₈ (■₁₅ a), else }
operators.plain: If 2 ≤ a < 7, apply ●₁₀ to 7, then apply ●₆ to the result and (a ♧₁₄); otherwise apply ■₁₅ to a, then apply ♧₈ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 若 2 ≤ a < 7，先对 7 应用 ●₁₀，再对结果和 a ♧₁₄ 应用 ●₆；否则先对 a 应用 ■₁₅，再对结果应用 ♧₈。

operators.name: ○₂₃
operators.definition: a ○₂₃ b = { ■₁₅ (a * b), if a < 3 and b >= 4 and b < 5; (♧₈ a) - (♧₂₂ b), else }
operators.plain: If a < 3 and b ≥ 4 and b < 5, multiply a by b, then apply ■₁₅ to the result; otherwise apply ♧₈ to a, then subtract ♧₂₂ b from it.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 3 且 b ≥ 4 且 b < 5，先把 a 乘以 b，再对结果应用 ■₁₅；否则先对 a 应用 ♧₈，再从结果中减去 ♧₂₂ b。

operators.name: ◆₂₄
operators.definition: a ◆₂₄ b = { (a ♣₁₃ a) ☆₅, if a >= 6 and b >= 5 and b < 10; ♡₁₂ (a ☆₁₉ 0), if a < 6 and b >= 1 and b < 2; 3 ♢₂ (♧₈ 0), else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 6 and b ≥ 5 and b < 10, apply ♣₁₃ to a and a, then apply ☆₅ to the result; otherwise if a < 6 and b ≥ 1 and b < 2, apply ☆₁₉ to a and 0, then apply ♡₁₂ to the result; otherwise apply ♢₂ to 3 and (♧₈ 0).
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 6 且 b ≥ 5 且 b < 10，先把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♣₁₃，再对结果应用 ☆₅；否则若 a < 6 且 b ≥ 1 且 b < 2，先对 a 和 0 应用 ☆₁₉，再对结果应用 ♡₁₂；否则对 3 和 ♧₈ 0 应用 ♢₂。

operators.name: ☆₂₅
operators.definition: a ☆₂₅ b = { (a □₁₁ b) ♠₂₁, if a >= 11 and b < 4; (- 1) ♠₂₁, if a < 6 and b >= 4 and b < 8; (a ◆₉) ♣₁₃ (♧₂₂ a), else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 11 and b < 4, apply □₁₁ to a and b, then apply ♠₂₁ to the result; otherwise if a < 6 and b ≥ 4 and b < 8, apply ♠₂₁ to -1; otherwise apply ◆₉ to a, then apply ♣₁₃ to the result and (♧₂₂ a).
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 11 且 b < 4，先对 a 和 b 应用 □₁₁，再对结果应用 ♠₂₁；否则若 a < 6 且 b ≥ 4 且 b < 8，对 -1 应用 ♠₂₁；否则先对 a 应用 ◆₉，再对结果和 ♧₂₂ a 应用 ♣₁₃。

operators.name: ♤₂₆
operators.definition: ♤₂₆ a = { ♡₁₂ (# a), if a >= 2 and a < 9; (a @) + (# a), else }
operators.plain: If 2 ≤ a < 9, take the signed triangle number of a, then apply ♡₁₂ to the result; otherwise reverse the digits of a, then add the signed triangle number of a to it.
operators.plain_zh: 若 2 ≤ a < 9，先求 a 的带符号三角数，再对结果应用 ♡₁₂；否则先把 a 的数字倒过来写，再把结果加上「a 的带符号三角数」。

operators.name: ◆₂₇
operators.definition: a ◆₂₇ b = { a, if a >= 10 and b >= 10; 0 - b, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 10 and b ≥ 10, return a; otherwise subtract b from 0.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 10 且 b ≥ 10，结果为 a；否则从 0 中减去 b。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: ♧₂₈
operators.definition: a ♧₂₈ b = { - (b □₁₁ a), if a < 7 and b >= 6; (1 ☆₅) % a, if a >= 8 and b >= 2 and b < 6; (0 ◆₉) ●₁₆ a, else }
operators.plain: If a < 7 and b ≥ 6, apply □₁₁ to b and a, then negate it; otherwise if a ≥ 8 and b ≥ 2 and b < 6, apply ☆₅ to 1, then take the remainder when dividing it by a; otherwise apply ◆₉ to 0, then apply ●₁₆ to the result and a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 7 且 b ≥ 6，先对 b 和 a 应用 □₁₁，再把结果取相反数；否则若 a ≥ 8 且 b ≥ 2 且 b < 6，先对 1 应用 ☆₅，再求结果除以 a 的余数；否则先对 0 应用 ◆₉，再对结果和 a 应用 ●₁₆。

operators.name: ◇₂₉
operators.definition: a ◇₂₉ b = { a * (♧₈ b), if a >= 9 and b >= 6; a, if a < 0 and b < 0; (♧₈ a) / a, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 9 and b ≥ 6, multiply a by ♧₈ b; otherwise if a < 0 and b < 0, return a; otherwise apply ♧₈ to a, then divide it by a, rounding toward zero.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 9 且 b ≥ 6，把 a 乘以 ♧₈ b；否则若 a < 0 且 b < 0，结果为 a；否则先对 a 应用 ♧₈，再把结果除以 a 并向零取整。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: ♢₃₀
operators.plain: Apply ♣₁₇ to a, then apply ●₁₆ to the result and (7 ☆₅).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ♣₁₇，再对结果和 7 ☆₅ 应用 ●₁₆。

operators.name: ■₃₁
operators.plain: If a < 0, sum the digits of 6, then apply ●₁₆ to the result and (7 ●₁₀); otherwise apply ♧₈ to a, then take the remainder when dividing it by a ◆₉.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 0，先求 6 的各位数字之和，再对结果和 7 ●₁₀ 应用 ●₁₆；否则先对 a 应用 ♧₈，再求结果除以 a ◆₉ 的余数。

operators.name: ★₃₂
operators.plain: Apply ●₁₀ to a, then apply △₁ to the result and a.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ●₁₀，再对结果和 a 应用 △₁。

operators.name: ♡₃₃
operators.plain: Apply ♢₂ to a and (♤₂₆ a).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 ♤₂₆ a 应用 ♢₂。

operators.name: ♤₃₄
operators.definition: a ♤₃₄ b = { ♢₃₀ (b ■₄ a), if a >= 9 and b >= 8; (1 ■₃₁) ■₄ (a ♠₂₁), else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 9 and b ≥ 8, apply ■₄ to b and a, then apply ♢₃₀ to the result; otherwise apply ■₃₁ to 1, then apply ■₄ to the result and (a ♠₂₁).
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 9 且 b ≥ 8，先对 b 和 a 应用 ■₄，再对结果应用 ♢₃₀；否则先对 1 应用 ■₃₁，再对结果和 a ♠₂₁ 应用 ■₄。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: ▲₃₅
operators.definition: a ▲₃₅ b = { a ♤₃₄ b, if a >= 11 and b < 4; a ♠₂₁, if a >= 0 and a < 6 and b < 4; a ◇₂₉ b, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 11 and b < 4, compute a ♤₃₄ b; otherwise if 0 ≤ a < 6 and b < 4, apply ♠₂₁ to a; otherwise compute a ◇₂₉ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 11 且 b < 4，对 a 和 b 应用 ♤₃₄；否则若 0 ≤ a < 6 且 b < 4，对 a 应用 ♠₂₁；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ◇₂₉。

operators.name: ○₃₆
operators.definition: a ○₃₆ b = { (b ☆₁₉ b) ♠₂₁, if a >= 3 and a < 9 and b >= 1; (♤₂₆ a) ▲₃₅ (a $), else }
operators.plain: If 3 ≤ a < 9 and b ≥ 1, apply ☆₁₉ to b and b, then apply ♠₂₁ to the result; otherwise apply ♤₂₆ to a, then apply ▲₃₅ to the result and (the number of one bits in a).
operators.plain_zh: 若 3 ≤ a < 9 且 b ≥ 1，先把 b 同时作为两个输入应用 ☆₁₉，再对结果应用 ♠₂₁；否则先对 a 应用 ♤₂₆，再对结果和「a 的二进制中 1 的个数」应用 ▲₃₅。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: ★₃₇
operators.definition: a ★₃₇ b = { b ●₁₀, if a >= 8 and b >= 0 and b < 6; (b ♧₁₄) ☆₁₉ a, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 8 and b ≥ 0 and b < 6, apply ●₁₀ to b; otherwise apply ♧₁₄ to b, then apply ☆₁₉ to the result and a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 8 且 b ≥ 0 且 b < 6，对 b 应用 ●₁₀；否则先对 b 应用 ♧₁₄，再对结果和 a 应用 ☆₁₉。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: ♥₃₈
operators.definition: a ♥₃₈ b = { a ■₄ b, if a >= 8 and b >= 3 and b < 7; ♡₁₂ b, if a < 8 and b >= 7 and b < 11; b ♧₂₈ b, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 8 and b ≥ 3 and b < 7, compute a ■₄ b; otherwise if a < 8 and b ≥ 7 and b < 11, apply ♡₁₂ to b; otherwise compute b ♧₂₈ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 8 且 b ≥ 3 且 b < 7，对 a 和 b 应用 ■₄；否则若 a < 8 且 b ≥ 7 且 b < 11，对 b 应用 ♡₁₂；否则把 b 同时作为两个输入应用 ♧₂₈。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: ◇₃₉
operators.plain: Apply ■₃₁ to a, then apply ○₃₆ to the result and (♢₃₀ a).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ■₃₁，再对结果和 ♢₃₀ a 应用 ○₃₆。

operators.name: ♠₄₀
operators.plain: Reverse the digits of a, then apply ☆₂₅ to the result and (the digit sum of a).
operators.plain_zh: 先把 a 的数字倒过来写，再对结果和「a 的数字和」应用 ☆₂₅。

operators.name: ♢₄₁
operators.definition: a ♢₄₁ b = { ♢₃₀ (a ○₂₃ b), if a < 1 and b >= 1 and b < 4; ♢₃₀ (a ◇₂₉ b), if a >= 1 and b >= 5 and b < 11; (b ▼₁₈) ★₃₇ a, else }
operators.plain: If a < 1 and b ≥ 1 and b < 4, apply ○₂₃ to a and b, then apply ♢₃₀ to the result; otherwise if a ≥ 1 and b ≥ 5 and b < 11, apply ◇₂₉ to a and b, then apply ♢₃₀ to the result; otherwise apply ▼₁₈ to b, then apply ★₃₇ to the result and a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 1 且 b ≥ 1 且 b < 4，先对 a 和 b 应用 ○₂₃，再对结果应用 ♢₃₀；否则若 a ≥ 1 且 b ≥ 5 且 b < 11，先对 a 和 b 应用 ◇₂₉，再对结果应用 ♢₃₀；否则先对 b 应用 ▼₁₈，再对结果和 a 应用 ★₃₇。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: ☆₄₂
operators.plain: Start with 6. Repeat |a % 8| times: apply ☆₅ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 6 开始，重复 |a % 8| 次：对结果应用 ☆₅。

operators.name: ★₄₃
operators.plain: Start with b. Repeat |a % 7| times: apply ○₂₃ to the current value and the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 b 开始，重复 |a % 7| 次：把结果同时作为两个输入应用 ○₂₃。

operators.name: ♥₄₄
operators.plain: Recurse on b, counting with b % 5: when b % 5 = 0 the result is 9; otherwise let r be the result for (b % 5) - 1 (or (b % 5) + 1 when b % 5 < 0), then apply △₁ to r and b.
operators.plain_zh: 对 b 递归，用 b % 5 计数：b % 5 = 0 时结果为 9；否则先求 (b % 5) - 1（b % 5 < 0 时用 (b % 5) + 1）的结果 r，再对 r 和 b 应用 △₁。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: ♧₄₅
operators.plain: Recurse on a, counting with a % 6: when a % 6 = 0 the result is 9; otherwise let r be the result for (a % 6) - 1 (or (a % 6) + 1 when a % 6 < 0), then apply ○₂₃ to r and a.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 递归，用 a % 6 计数：a % 6 = 0 时结果为 9；否则先求 (a % 6) - 1（a % 6 < 0 时用 (a % 6) + 1）的结果 r，再对 r 和 a 应用 ○₂₃。

operators.name: □₄₆
operators.plain: Recurse on b, counting with b % 7: when b % 7 = 0 the result is a; otherwise let r be the result for (b % 7) - 1 (or (b % 7) + 1 when b % 7 < 0), then replace r by b ☆₁₉ r.

operators.name: ♤₆₆
operators.definition: ♤₆₆ a = { (a ☆₅) ○₂₃ (★₃₂ a), if a < 0; (a ☆₂₅ a) ☆₆₅, if a >= 3; (♢₃₀ a) ☆₅₄ (♡₃₃ a), else }
operators.plain: If a < 0, apply ☆₅ to a, then apply ○₂₃ to the result and (★₃₂ a); otherwise if a ≥ 3, apply ☆₂₅ to a and a, then apply ☆₆₅ to the result; otherwise apply ♢₃₀ to a, then apply ☆₅₄ to the result and (♡₃₃ a).
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 0，先对 a 应用 ☆₅，再对结果和 ★₃₂ a 应用 ○₂₃；否则若 a ≥ 3，先把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ☆₂₅，再对结果应用 ☆₆₅；否则先对 a 应用 ♢₃₀，再对结果和 ♡₃₃ a 应用 ☆₅₄。

operators.name: ♧₆₇
operators.definition: a ♧₆₇ b = { a □₄₆ a, if a >= 4 and a < 10 and b >= 4 and b < 11; b % b, if a < 4 and b >= 4 and b < 11; b ◇₃ b, else }
operators.plain: If 4 ≤ a < 10 and b ≥ 4 and b < 11, compute a □₄₆ a; otherwise if a < 4 and b ≥ 4 and b < 11, take the remainder when dividing b by b; otherwise compute b ◇₃ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 4 ≤ a < 10 且 b ≥ 4 且 b < 11，把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 □₄₆；否则若 a < 4 且 b ≥ 4 且 b < 11，求 b 除以 b 的余数；否则把 b 同时作为两个输入应用 ◇₃。

operators.name: ♦₆₈
operators.definition: a ♦₆₈ b = { 6 ○₄₇ a, if a < 6 and b >= 3 and b < 8; b ◆₆₂, if a >= 6 and a < 7 and b >= 3 and b < 8; 4 ♥₃₈ b, else }
operators.plain: If a < 6 and b ≥ 3 and b < 8, compute 6 ○₄₇ a; otherwise if 6 ≤ a < 7 and b ≥ 3 and b < 8, apply ◆₆₂ to b; otherwise compute 4 ♥₃₈ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 6 且 b ≥ 3 且 b < 8，对 6 和 a 应用 ○₄₇；否则若 6 ≤ a < 7 且 b ≥ 3 且 b < 8，对 b 应用 ◆₆₂；否则对 4 和 b 应用 ♥₃₈。

operators.name: ♦₆₉
operators.definition: a ♦₆₉ b = { b, if a < 3 and b >= 1 and b < 2; 1 ♧₅₀, if a < 3 and b < 1; b ♤₆₄ b, else }

operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 3 且 b ≥ 1 且 b < 2，结果为 b；否则若 a < 3 且 b < 1，对 1 应用 ♧₅₀；否则把 b 同时作为两个输入应用 ♤₆₄。

operators.name: ♡₇₀
operators.definition: ♡₇₀ a = { 2 ■₄ a, if a >= 5; a ★₆₀, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 5, compute 2 ■₄ a; otherwise apply ★₆₀ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 5，对 2 和 a 应用 ■₄；否则对 a 应用 ★₆₀。

operators.name: ♠₇₁
operators.definition: a ♠₇₁ b = { ◆₆₃ (b ♥₃₈ 0), if a >= 1 and b >= 10; (☆₄₂ b) @, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 1 and b ≥ 10, apply ♥₃₈ to b and 0, then apply ◆₆₃ to the result; otherwise apply ☆₄₂ to b, then reverse its digits.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 1 且 b ≥ 10，先对 b 和 0 应用 ♥₃₈，再对结果应用 ◆₆₃；否则先对 b 应用 ☆₄₂，再把结果的数字倒过来写。

operators.name: ○₇₂
